description: Use the actual platform or signed backend challenge entry mechanism. No fabricated QR code is included.
integrity_rules: challengeId must belong to an actual challenge
expiry must come from authoritative server clock
code or link must resolve and be scan/launch tested
never cache a placeholder as a functional code
respect specific platform signing and size requirements
display_guidance: Keep share-card bottom entrance reserved 180px. Insert provider-issued real code at runtime. If not available, show appropriate dynamic status text and disable share action.
